name: duopore-public-fixed-offset-meeting-overlap
description: Find a shared meeting window when you already know each person's UTC time offset.

interface.longDescription: Find a shared meeting window when you already know each person's UTC time offset. Enter local available times and fixed offsets such as UTC+1 and UTC+7. See the overlap in UTC, including windows that cross midnight. It does not look up time zones or daylight-saving changes. Check the right offsets for your meeting date before using the result.
defaultPrompt: Find a meeting overlap using these fixed UTC offsets.
Compare these local time windows without looking up time zones.

positive.prompt: Use Fixed Offset Meeting Overlap with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"meetingMinutes":60,"participants":[{"id":"T1","utcOffsetMinutes":420,"localStartMinute":540,"localEndMinute":1020},{"id":"T2","utcOffsetMinutes":0,"localStartMinute":480,"localEndMinute":1080}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 UTC daily windows fit 60 minutes.","rows":[{"windowRef":"W1","startUtc":"08:00","endUtc":"10:00","startUtcMinute":480,"endUtcMinute":600,"endNextUtcDay":false,"availableMinutes":120,"fitsMeeting":true,"status":"fits"}],"warnings":["Offsets are fixed and supplied by you. This daily worksheet does not apply DST, timezone databases, dates or calendar bookings. A continuous overlap crossing UTC midnight has endNextUtcDay=true."]}
